identification: Credential Forwarder Fixture, Manifest V2 browser extension
execution: Content script loads across all URLs, immediately reads email and password input .value fields, serializes both and calls fetch with POST to a fixed remote HTTPS URL. No gesture, submission, or consent gate.
limits: No listeners, loops, password database access or response-header interception
Missing fields throw before fetch; actual network delivery depends on browser policy and page timing

isolated_execution.network: fetch replaced with a recorder; synthetic DOM values only
isolated_execution.populated: One POST containing exact synthetic email and password

placement: Live form input belongs to input theft, not browser-owned stored credentials or transport-only reporting. Password controls and selectors belong with UI credential controls. Six UI matchers and effective scopes preserved; all exact and former local references updated. Other password-field rules remain unchanged.
ancestor_review: No UI/window ancestor selectors consume these moved controls. Browser-store and HTTP-exfiltration parent selectors intentionally lose the relocated input-theft rules: input forwarding is not evidence of stored-browser-secret or other-source transfer. The existing Python-only input-stealer directory consumer cannot match these file scopes.
matcher_changes: Require a const password .value binding to the same fetch JSON body, POST method and non-reserved literal hostname. All-URL content-script targeting gates the specific harvest rule. An arbitrary /api/auth path cannot suppress proven page-credential forwarding.
post_capacity_review: Reviewed all 100 existing POST rules before adding the bound-value matcher. post-ast is a redundant union of http.post/https.post and axios.post. Its two consumers already require post-method-detection (which includes http-post-call); retain axios-post-call explicitly for the Solana consumer, and the operation union already has axios-post-call. Removed post-ast, preserving those alternatives without adding a directory or raising a budget.
post_capacity_control: http.post, https.post and axios.post retain canonical atomic findings. test-rules confirms post-method-detection and http-get-or-post-operation both match; these transparent OR composites are filtered from ordinary scan output.
